# Plot

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Drawing](BlitzBasic-Drawing)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Plot:Void x:Int32, y:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |

## Description

Draws a single pixel in the drawing color.
